section_summary.extract_value: This section describes a single study that examined the factor structure and psychometric properties of a Malay translation of the BAS-2 in Malaysian adults, including EFA and CFA and tests of measurement invariance across sex and major ethnic groups. The study also evaluated construct and convergent validity (including associations with self-reported BMI) and incremental validity predicting subjective happiness above negative body image and media influences.
